name: @yupcha/chrome-extension
description: Yupcha Capture — Chrome MV3 extension that extracts structured data (tables, repeated lists, LinkedIn people results) from the current page and pushes it into a Yupcha workbook via the inbound rows ingest API.

scripts.dev: echo '@yupcha/chrome-extension — no dev server; run build and load dist/ unpacked'
scripts.zip: bun run build && cd dist && zip -r ../yupcha-chrome-extension.zip .
